accept.name: reverify-drops-unwitnessed-object-set-cancel
accept.note: Dropping an unwitnessed retired-key cancel on reverify follows the locked rule: only a witnessed cancel survives.

reject.name: merge-drops-an-object-set-that-arrives-first
reject.note: An object-set row merged in before this graph holds the admitted signed object record is dropped. A later record does not revive it.
